title: Finite direct sums of finite-presentation modules are finite presentation
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and let $\mathcal G,\mathcal H$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If each is of finite presentation (locally the cokernel of a map $\mathcal O_X^{\oplus m}\to\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ with $m,n$ finite), then the biproduct $\mathcal G\oplus\mathcal H$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ is of finite presentation.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PJ proof, lines 3070-3090: the direct sum of two finite-presentation modules is finite presentation; this is immediate by taking the direct sum of the local presentations in Modules, Definition 01BN (tag 01BN)
